name: 门店零售 · 准确率评测
description: 常见经营问题。标准答案由参考 SQL 在评测时从当前数据计算；涉及具体门店的题目也在评测时从门店表中选取，文件里不含任何门店名称和经营数字。

cases.question: 最新一个月四家门店的销售额合计是多少？

checks.sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM fact_store_sales WHERE month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales)

cases.question: 最新一个月所有门店的毛利合计是多少？

checks.sql: SELECT SUM(gross_profit) FROM fact_store_sales WHERE month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales)

cases.question: 最新一个月{store}店的毛利是多少？

checks.sql: SELECT SUM(s.gross_profit) FROM fact_store_sales s JOIN dim_store d USING (store_id) WHERE d.short_name = :store AND s.month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales)

params.store: SELECT short_name FROM dim_store ORDER BY store_id LIMIT 1

cases.question: 最新一个月毛利最高的是哪家门店？

checks.sql: SELECT d.short_name FROM fact_store_sales s JOIN dim_store d USING (store_id) WHERE s.month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales) GROUP BY d.short_name ORDER BY SUM(s.gross_profit) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 最新一个月一共卖了多少台手机？

checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_phone) FROM fact_store_sales WHERE month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales)

cases.question: 最新一个月哪家门店卖的手机最多？卖了多少台？

checks.sql: SELECT d.short_name FROM fact_store_sales s JOIN dim_store d USING (store_id) WHERE s.month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales) GROUP BY d.short_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.is_phone) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.is_phone) FROM fact_store_sales s WHERE s.month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales) GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 最新一个月所有门店整体的毛利率是多少？

checks.sql: SELECT SUM(gross_profit) / NULLIF(SUM(sale_price), 0) FROM fact_store_sales WHERE month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales)

cases.question: 最新一个月毛利最高的店员是谁？

checks.sql: SELECT salesperson FROM fact_store_sales WHERE month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales) AND salesperson IS NOT NULL GROUP BY salesperson ORDER BY SUM(gross_profit) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: {store}店最新一个月的总毛利目标是多少？

checks.sql: SELECT t.target_value FROM fact_store_targets t JOIN dim_store d USING (store_id) WHERE d.short_name = :store AND t.owner_type = 'store' AND t.item = '总毛利' AND t.unit = '毛利' AND t.month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_targets) LIMIT 1

params.store: SELECT short_name FROM dim_store ORDER BY store_id LIMIT 1

cases.question: 库龄超过 90 天的库存金额一共是多少？

checks.sql: SELECT SUM(cost_price * quantity) FROM fact_stock_age WHERE age_days > 90

cases.question: 库龄超过 90 天的商品一共有多少件？

checks.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM fact_stock_age WHERE age_days > 90

cases.question: 微信收款成功的一共有多少笔？

checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_payments WHERE channel = '微信' AND status = 'SUCCESS'

cases.question: 手机台数是怎么统计的？平板算不算？
每个门店最新一个月的销售额

checks.sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM fact_store_sales WHERE month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales) GROUP BY store_id

cases.question: 最新一个月每个门店卖了多少台手机

checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_phone) FROM fact_store_sales WHERE month_label = (SELECT MAX(month_label) FROM fact_store_sales) GROUP BY store_id

cases.question: 按月统计所有门店的销售额

checks.sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM fact_store_sales GROUP BY month_label
